title: K3 Track TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the AGV K3 Track TC-3 at 1417 grams. Built with a Thermoplastic shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, ECE 22.06 safety standards.

product_details.description: Versatile road helmet with internal sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for track use with a very snug, locked-in fit; often requires cheek pads to be fully compressed or removed for optimal comfort on long rides. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K3 Track TC-3 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
yoast_title: AGV K3 Track TC-3 Review: 1417g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the AGV K3 Track TC-3. Verified 1417g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, ECE 22.06 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.
editorial_excerpt: This helmet delivers uncompromising aerodynamic stability at speed while the MIPS system effectively manages rotational forces during aggressive cornering.
story_narrative: The AGV K3 Track TC-3 features a 1480 g shell engineered for track aerodynamic stability and ECE 22.06 safety. High-velocity chin vents channel air through deep EPS grooves, maintaining cool airflow at triple-digit speeds. The MIPS liner rotates independently to dissipate rotational energy during high-G cornering, while the optical clarity of the polycarbonate visor resists glare under harsh midday sun. I clipped the TC-3 mount directly to the D-ring system, tightened the strap until the buckle sat flush against my jawline, and secured the chin bar with a single firm click.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV K3 Track TC-3 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K3 Track TC-3 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The AGV K3 Track TC-3 represents Italian head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Thermoplastic shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Thermoplastic Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the K3 Track TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.

fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 15-20 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~20% for facial fitment.

pros: Lightweight 1417g Thermoplastic shell reduces neck fatigue
Distortion-free Class-1 optical shield with wide field of view

cons: Firm 3D cheek pads require 15-20 riding hours break-in
